title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.value: Nonuniform spacing in this short sample: the first interval is longest, followed by several shorter intervals with another longer gap before the fifth trough.
fields.basis: Provisional negative trough-to-trough spacing in original PDF 591
fields.reason: Selected pixel gaps: 145 px, 118 px, 113 px, 132.5 px, 110 px. These describe a short sample, not a validated rhythm classification.

fields.basis: Assumed course speed 25 mm/s; 149 detected lines enclose 148 minor horizontal intervals across 727 pixels in the observed calibration segment.
fields.reason: 5 retained negative trough-to-trough intervals have mean spacing 123.70 px, giving 59.6 bpm. No numerical speed label or labeled timing duration is verified on this strip. This is interval-derived, not a six-second beat count or a claim of a stable rate.

fields.value: Six positive-then-deeper-negative sharp complexes followed by broad rounded upward deflections. The raster is visibly softer/lower contrast than the other seven pages. Small pre-complex deflections vary and are not assigned atrial identity.
fields.basis: New descriptive observation of the original raster, not a source-authored rhythm diagnosis
fields.reason: No diagnostic rhythm label, validated P-wave identity, validated conduction interval or clinical conclusion is assigned. Conditional interval estimates, where present, remain unvalidated. Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.

pr unresolved: The shallow candidates are not equally reproducible, and the differently directed precomplex event could represent another component. Event-specific candidate onset-to-onset arithmetic is retained, but a numeric PR field is withheld pending P identity review.
No validated atrial identity or atrioventricular relationship; visible bumps/oscillations are described without asserting P-wave presence or absence.
No secure P onset and conduction relationship, and no verified individual-strip speed.
Onset/offset boundaries in this resampled raster are not validated; sharpness does not establish a numerical QRS duration.
Ventricular onset and terminal repolarization boundary are not validated; no correction formula is applied.
Per-strip gain/calibration is not verified; no quantitative amplitude is assigned.
Not derived from morphology or rate alone; qualified educator review required.

All derived fields remain provisional and excluded from validated scoring.
Only the directly observed horizontal calibration segment is used. Its line count may exclude strip borders; no full-strip duration is inferred from unlabeled marks or a prior page.

Pixel-picking and grid-sensitivity allowances are illustrative, not confidence intervals. Unknown paper speed, missed events, waveform identity and phase comparability are not bounded by those allowances.
A mean can conceal changing spacing. No sustained rate or diagnostic rhythm is inferred.

The initial 15-prominence trials miss 5–6 faint lines; narrower top bands also miss or split lines at other settings. Wider clear bands at the recorded selected thresholds independently recover contiguous 4–6 px gaps and agree within one pixel. Failed trials remain recorded. find_peaks excludes the x-range endpoints. The line arrays are interior measured calibration spans, not a full-width duration count; page 587 has a different grid phase and a different detected count.
All six clear negative troughs are retained. Broad post-complex humps and small pre-complex deflections are not additional ventricular events. No partial edge complex is used.
